description: Retrieval evaluation set for IncarnaMind v1 (issue #21), run by `npm run eval` (eval/README.md, issue #31).
hitRule: A question is a hit if one of the top 5 retrieved Passages (a) belongs to expected.document, (b) has a page range that covers expected.pages, and (c) contains expected.quote after both are normalised (src/shared/text.ts normaliseText, matched by src/shared/quoteMatch.ts findQuote: NFKC, CJK radical folding, unified quotes/dashes/full-width punctuation, end-of-line hyphenation removed, whitespace collapsed, whitespace next to CJK characters removed).
pageNumbers: Physical 1-based page index as pdf.js reports it, not the printed page label.
core: The 40 questions with neither crossLingual: true nor paraphrase: true (20 en, 20 zh) are the gating set. crossLingual questions (Chinese questions about English documents, and English questions about Chinese documents) are reported separately.
translatedQuery: A crossLingual question may have translatedQuery: the question translated by hand into its document's language. It is searched as a second query, standing in for the second search an Answer makes in the documents' language, and a hit in either search's top 5 counts. Reported only, as the most that approach can bring.
paraphrase: paraphrase: true marks a question that asks for a fact on one page in words that avoid the target passage's distinctive words (synonyms, descriptions, the kind of question a person asks without the text in front of them). 15 of them (8 en, 7 zh), reported as a group of their own and kept out of the gating set, its bar and its per-language counts.
